Broccoli - Bacon Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:01am

Ingredients




1 bunch broccoli, about 3 stalks
1 sm. red onion, thinly sliced
12 strips bacon, crisply fried
1 cup whole roasted sunflower seeds
1/2 cup raisins
1 cup mayonnaise, light or regular
1/2 cup sugar
2 tablespoons vinegar

Preparation

1 Completely chop broccoli. If using a food processor, cut up the flowerettes by hand so they don't get smaller than bite size. Add onion slices. Crumble in bacon and add sunflower seeds and raisins. 2 For the dressing, combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar. Mix with wire whisk until sugar is dissolved. Add to vegetables and toss. Makes 12 servings.
